---
title: "Myths vs Facts"
---

:::: {.myths-page}
  <p class="myths-intro">Snakebite advice can be confusing. Decide whether each statement is a myth or a fact, then see a short explanation.</p>

::: {.myth-quiz}
<div class="myth-quiz-topline">
  <p id="myth-question-count">Question 1 of 6</p>
  <p id="myth-score">0/6 correct</p>
</div>
<progress id="myth-progress" class="myth-progress" max="6" value="0" aria-label="Quiz progress"></progress>

<div id="myth-question-panel" class="myth-question" aria-live="polite">
  <p class="myth-question-label">Myth or fact?</p>
  <h2 id="myth-quiz-heading" tabindex="-1"></h2>
</div>

<div id="myth-answer-controls" class="myth-answer-controls" role="group" aria-label="Choose whether the statement is a myth or a fact">
  <button type="button" data-answer="Myth">Myth</button>
  <button type="button" data-answer="Fact">Fact</button>
</div>

<p id="myth-feedback" class="myth-feedback" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
<button id="myth-next" class="myth-next" type="button" hidden>Next statement</button>

<div id="myth-result" class="myth-result" hidden>
  <p class="myth-question-label">Quiz complete</p>
  <h2>Your score: <span id="myth-final-score"></span></h2>
  <p id="myth-result-message"></p>
  <button id="myth-restart" class="myth-restart" type="button">Try again</button>
</div>
:::
::::

<script>
const snakebiteStatements = [
  {
    statement: "You should suck the venom out of a snakebite.",
    answer: "Myth",
    explanation: "Suction does not remove venom effectively and may worsen injury or delay emergency care."
  },
  {
    statement: "All snakes are venomous.",
    answer: "Myth",
    explanation: "Most snake species are not venomous. Still, treat any suspected bite as an emergency and do not handle the snake."
  },
  {
    statement: "A snake can bite you after it is dead.",
    answer: "Fact",
    explanation: "Reflex movements can persist after death, and a bite may still deliver venom. Never touch or pick up a dead snake."
  },
  {
    statement: "Snakes will chase you if provoked.",
    answer: "Myth",
    explanation: "Most snakes prefer to escape. A snake that feels cornered may defend itself, so give it space and move away calmly."
  },
  {
    statement: "Keeping the bite below heart level slows venom spread.",
    answer: "Fact",
    explanation: "Some first-aid guidance recommends keeping the affected limb still and below heart level if possible. Follow local emergency advice, since protocols can vary."
  },
  {
    statement: "Applying a tight tourniquet helps after a snakebite.",
    answer: "Myth",
    explanation: "A tight tourniquet can restrict circulation and cause serious tissue damage. Keep the person still and get urgent medical help instead."
  }
];

const questionCount = document.getElementById("myth-question-count");
const scoreLabel = document.getElementById("myth-score");
const progressBar = document.getElementById("myth-progress");
const questionHeading = document.getElementById("myth-quiz-heading");
const questionPanel = document.getElementById("myth-question-panel");
const answerControls = document.getElementById("myth-answer-controls");
const answerButtons = [...answerControls.querySelectorAll("button")];
const feedback = document.getElementById("myth-feedback");
const nextButton = document.getElementById("myth-next");
const resultPanel = document.getElementById("myth-result");
const finalScore = document.getElementById("myth-final-score");
const resultMessage = document.getElementById("myth-result-message");
const restartButton = document.getElementById("myth-restart");

let currentQuestion = 0;
let correctAnswers = 0;
let hasAnswered = false;

function renderQuestion(moveFocus = false) {
  const item = snakebiteStatements[currentQuestion];
  questionCount.textContent = `Question ${currentQuestion + 1} of ${snakebiteStatements.length}`;
  scoreLabel.textContent = `${correctAnswers}/${snakebiteStatements.length} correct`;
  progressBar.value = currentQuestion;
  questionHeading.textContent = item.statement;
  questionPanel.hidden = false;
  answerControls.hidden = false;
  resultPanel.hidden = true;
  feedback.hidden = true;
  feedback.className = "myth-feedback";
  nextButton.hidden = true;
  hasAnswered = false;
  answerButtons.forEach((button) => { button.disabled = false; });
  if (moveFocus) questionHeading.focus();
}

function showResult() {
  progressBar.value = snakebiteStatements.length;
  questionPanel.hidden = true;
  answerControls.hidden = true;
  feedback.hidden = true;
  nextButton.hidden = true;
  resultPanel.hidden = false;
  finalScore.textContent = `${correctAnswers}/${snakebiteStatements.length}`;
  resultMessage.textContent = correctAnswers === snakebiteStatements.length
    ? "Excellent work. Keep relying on qualified emergency and medical guidance."
    : "Thanks for playing. For a real bite, contact emergency services or a poison center immediately.";
  restartButton.focus();
}

answerButtons.forEach((button) => {
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (hasAnswered) return;
    hasAnswered = true;
    const item = snakebiteStatements[currentQuestion];
    const isCorrect = button.dataset.answer === item.answer;
    if (isCorrect) correctAnswers += 1;
    scoreLabel.textContent = `${correctAnswers}/${snakebiteStatements.length} correct`;
    answerButtons.forEach((answerButton) => { answerButton.disabled = true; });
    feedback.textContent = `${isCorrect ? "Correct." : `The answer is ${item.answer.toLowerCase()}.`} ${item.explanation}`;
    feedback.classList.toggle("is-incorrect", !isCorrect);
    feedback.hidden = false;
    nextButton.textContent = currentQuestion === snakebiteStatements.length - 1
      ? "See your score"
      : "Next statement";
    nextButton.hidden = false;
    nextButton.focus();
  });
});

nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
  currentQuestion += 1;
  if (currentQuestion === snakebiteStatements.length) {
    showResult();
  } else {
    renderQuestion(true);
  }
});

restartButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
  currentQuestion = 0;
  correctAnswers = 0;
  renderQuestion(true);
});

renderQuestion();
</script>
